subject: Your sync just lost a whole day of my notes
body:
I am honestly furious right now.

I spent all of yesterday at a conference taking notes on my iPad in Acme Notes. This morning I opened the app on my iPhone and EVERYTHING from yesterday is gone. Now it's gone from the iPad too. Sync is the entire reason I use this app. A full day of work, just vanished.

I need those notes back today. If this is how you treat loyal customers, I'm done with Acme Notes.

Sofia Alvarez
